2607.29125.title: M3-DuplexBench: A Multi-Turn, Multilingual, Multidomain Benchmark for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models
2607.29125.paper_summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems (FDSDSs) can listen while speaking, enabling natural behaviors such as smooth turn-taking, backchannel handling, and user barge-in handling. However, fair comparisons in multi-turn conversations remain a challenge. In addition, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of languages and dialogue domains. We propose M3-DuplexBench, a multi-turn, multilingual, multidomain benchmark for FDSDSs. M3-DuplexBench supports English and Japanese and covers both casual conversation and multi-turn question answering. In addition, we evaluate models under multiple dialogue context settings, including single-turn, user-only, and teacher-forced full-context settings, to analyze how dialogue history affects model behavior. Experiments with recent FDSDSs reveal model-specific turn-taking characteristics, clear performance gaps across languages and domains, and mixed effects of dialogue context.
2607.29125.paper_summary_zh: 全雙工語音對話系統（FDSDSs）可以在講話的同時進行聆聽，從而實現自然的行為，例如流暢的輪流發言、回饋通道處理和用戶插話處理。<lb/>然而，在多輪對話中進行公平比較仍然是一個挑戰。此外，現有的基準測試對語言和對話領域的覆蓋範圍有限。<lb/>我們提出了 M3-DuplexBench，一個多輪、多語言、多領域的 FDSDS 基準測試。<lb/>M3-DuplexBench 支援英語和日語，並涵蓋休閒對話和多輪問答。<lb/>此外，我們在多種對話上下文設置下評估模型，包括單輪、僅用戶和教師強制的完整上下文設置，以分析對話歷史如何影響模型行為。<lb/>對近期 FDSDS 的實驗顯示了模型特定的輪流發言特徵、不同語言和領域之間明顯的性能差距，以及對話上下文的混合影響。
